subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2436
title: Provides that an official or agency of state government may not discriminate or grant preferential treatment to any individual on the basis of gender identity, race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin in the application, selection or appointment of individuals to boards and commissions.
headline: HB 2436 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2436 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2436 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
